summary: Iteration 71 — Scenic Discoveries CRUD, Journeys API and Live Scenic Ride HUD tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed (discoveries CRUD, idempotency per route_id+poi_order, PATCH 404, cross-user isolation, DELETE, journeys shape, regression on /api/scenic/routes /routes/{id} /routes/{id}/pois /favourites). Frontend: Journeys screen renders 'Journeys' title, journey-<routeId> recap cards with distance/time/discovery counts, journey-share-<routeId> button opens a share modal exposing recap-share / recap-save / recap-close testIDs. Live Scenic HUD (/scenic-ride?route=lake-garda) loads with progress ring, % explored, remaining, Time and km metrics. Critically, cadence 'rpm' and heart-rate 'bpm' labels are HIDDEN when no BLE sensor is connected (web/Expo Go), matching the requested user choice. poi-save bookmark toggles a discovery: POST /api/scenic/discoveries persists it (verified via GET), and tapping again deletes it — all rider-scoped.
critical_code_review_comments: scenic.py DiscoveryPatch: body.dict(exclude_unset=True) followed by (v or '').strip() will convert explicit None to '' silently. Acceptable for this use (all three fields are strings), but tests confirm behaviour.
scenic.py add_discovery: idempotent branch uses existing['id'] to update — depends on id existing in the doc; since inserts always add uuid this is safe.
seed_data_creation: No persistent test data — POST/DELETE pairs clean up their own discoveries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (loaded via python-dotenv in the test file). Frontend web auth stores the bearer token in localStorage under key 'roujaune_token' (see /app/frontend/src/lib/session.ts). Rider greenlantern has 2 real scenic-* rides in ride_history (Lake Garda), so /api/scenic/journeys returns 2 entries and the Journeys screen shows recap cards — expected. Demo account had 0. YouTube iframe autoplay is blocked by browser policy in headless Chromium (PAGEERROR 'play() failed because the user didn't interact') — this is a browser policy, not a code bug; the HUD still renders and the currentTime bindings/POI logic and BLE-hidden behaviour verified via DOM inspection.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found for the reviewed features.
